records.name: Annapurna I
records.detail: Known for its demanding climbing conditions

updates.title: Build skills before attempting a high-altitude climb
updates.text: Begin with fitness, navigation, rope skills and supervised practice on suitable terrain.

updates.title: Weather planning remains essential
updates.text: Mountain weather can change quickly. Check reliable forecasts and agree on a turn-around plan.

updates.title: Learn from local climbing groups
updates.text: Clubs and experienced guides can help new climbers understand local conditions and safe practices.
